about.lead: Markish Tech is a software development studio from Buenos Aires, Argentina. We design and build custom websites, web applications and SaaS platforms with the same technical standard from start to finish.
what: Markish Tech is a software development studio. We work across the whole journey of a digital product: research, design, frontend and backend development, launch and continuous improvement.

Besides building for clients, we build our own products. That forces us to solve the same problems our clients face: scaling, maintaining code, measuring performance and keeping a product running in production.
who: Markish Tech was founded by Marcos Hernán Parella, a software developer who designs and builds the studio's products and projects, from architecture and backend to the interface.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
body: Markish Tech, a software development studio in Buenos Aires, Argentina, founded by Marcos Hernán Parella. You can write to us about your data at {email}.

sections.title: What data we collect
body: When you fill in the contact form we receive your name, your email, the type of service you chose and the message you wrote. We don't ask for sensitive data.
If you write to us on WhatsApp or by email, we receive the data you send through that channel.

sections.title: What we use it for
body: We only use your data to reply to your inquiry and, if you ask us to, prepare a proposal. We don't use it to send you advertising and we don't sell it or hand it to third parties for their own purposes.

sections.title: How it is processed
body: The form sends your inquiry by email to Markish Tech's inbox through Google's email service (Gmail). The site is hosted on Vercel. These providers process data only to deliver those services.

sections.title: Analytics and cookies
body: This site doesn't use cookies. To know how many people visit it we use Vercel Web Analytics, which records aggregated data (for example page views, referring site, country and device type) without cookies and without identifying people.
Your light or dark theme preference is stored in your browser's local storage and is never sent to a server.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: We keep messages as long as needed to reply to your inquiry and manage any resulting business relationship. You can ask us to delete them at any time.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can request access to, correction, update or deletion of your data by writing to {email}. We reply within the timeframes set by Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law No. 25,326.

The Agency for Access to Public Information, as the supervisory authority of Law No. 25,326, has the power to handle complaints and claims filed by anyone whose rights are affected by non-compliance with personal data protection rules.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: If we change how we handle your data, we will update this page and its last-updated date.
